rubrics.persistence: 5 evergreen · 4 durable with minor dating · 3 partly dated · 2 largely dated data · 1 period piece or superseded (judgement, with reason given per work)
rubrics.editions: 1 + 4·ln(n)/ln(max), where n = ISBN editions in the dataset + annual cover-years commissioned; +0.5 if translated (capped at 5). Print runs are not public; publisher sales claims are noted where found.
rubrics.images_ip: Rough size of the IP portfolio: 5 = brand, series and large licensed image set (Top 10 of Everything); 4 = heavily illustrated or brandable series; 3 = owned text plus licensed fine-art images, or a substantial text database; 2 = small illustrated or anthology works; 1 = little IP or unknown
rubrics.publisher: Based on the most recent English-language publisher. 5 = active Big Five imprint · 4 = Big Five owner, imprint retired · 3 = active non-Big-Five publisher · 2 = status unverified · 1 = defunct or unknown. Scores rights-holder clarity; reverse it if you see defunct publishers as rights-reversion opportunities.

notes: Picture-credit evidence comes from full-text search of Internet Archive scans; names found in the text are taken as credits for picture agencies only.

Agency ownership: Hulton, Allsport and Popperfoto are Getty Images archives; Corbis and Bettmann images are owned by Visual China Group and distributed by Getty; Rex Features is part of Shutterstock; DK Picture Library belongs to Penguin Random House.
